info.title: Finance Calendar API
info.summary: Economic releases, central bank decisions and exchange holidays as JSON, CSV and ICS.
info.description: Every scheduled release on financecalendar.com, verified against official calendars and updated within the hour of a print. Free for any use, commercial included, with attribution: a visible link to https://www.financecalendar.com wherever the data appears. No key needed; a free key raises the daily limit. Earnings dates are not included.
